title: pilosella schultesii subsp. glaucoviridis
intro: Pilosella schultesii subsp. glaucoviridis, commonly known as a type of plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae), is a specific subspecies within the Pilosella genus. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella schultesii subsp. glaucoviridis include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella schultesii subsp. glaucoviridis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
